exposure: Mifepristone-misoprostol regime for late termination of pregnancy (TOP)
outcome: Time interval between first induction with misoprostol and fetal expulsion
cohort: 913 women undergoing TOPs, including 197 who had a previous feticide
finding: Lower gestational age at induction and a history of at least one previous vaginal delivery were significantly associated with a shorter delivery duration (<12 h) in women undergoing late TOP with a mifepristone-misoprostol regime.
